text: {"assertions":["A wrong environment bug in platform/config/loader.py was investigated on 2026-04-26, manifesting only when the input list came in empty.","The bug presented as a production endpoint being used in a staging process.","The root cause of the bug was identified as clock skew between two hosts.","The fix involved switching the deadline to a monotonic clock, implemented in PR #3454 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1.","The bug can be reproduced by booting the service with an unset profile variable.","After applying the fix, a previously flaky test stopped failing, improving from 40 failures per 100 runs to zero."]}
